input.summary: Cap the Termination Payment at three months of fees
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 4.1 already lets us exit on ninety days' notice, but the Section 4.2(a) Termination Payment is an uncapped penalty tied to Net Sales, so we have capped it at three months of the fees payable under Section 3.1, consistent with our fallback position on early-termination fees.

ops.oldText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
ops.newText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two; provided that the Termination Payment shall not exceed three (3) months of the fees payable by the Company under Section 3.1.
